assertions.description: When xmlBufResetInput sees a buffer error, the parser input must clear its stale base pointer to the empty-string sentinel before later error-reporting uses the input stream.
The parser input base observed at xmlLoadEntityContent is the same parser-input base that reaches the later reset-on-error decision.
The stale parser current pointer left unchanged at the reset-on-error point is the same pointer consumed by the file-context printer.
In the crashing vulnerable execution, the file-context printer scans from the current parser pointer within the same input range.
